contents: Contents: 54 wooden blocks, 54 cards, 1 blindfold, 1 travel bag.
rules: Stack the blocks and take turns pulling one out.
Match the symbol to one of 6 card categories, then pick a card, and choose which level you'd like to play.
Bonus: a '?' block is a mystery. Its category symbol is on the long side, so you only find out which category you've got once you've pulled it.
If you knock the stacked tower over, you lose, and have to give your partner anything they want tonight.
Every card is optional: either of you can skip any card, any time, with no forfeit.

activities: Spinning: only spin on a soft, clear floor area such as a rug, away from furniture, stairs and hard edges, or skip the card. Stop if you feel dizzy.
Lifting and carrying: do not lift, carry or give a piggyback if either of you has back, neck or joint problems or any injury. Skip the card instead.
Never lead a blindfolded partner near stairs, balconies, outside doors, water, hot surfaces or sharp edges.
Massage, poses and physical contact: use gentle pressure, do not press on the neck or spine, do not hold any position that causes pain or strain, and stop at once if your partner asks.
Props: use only soft, safe household items. Never use sharp, breakable, heated or electrical objects.
Never place the blindfold over the nose or in the mouth, never use it as a gag, and never tie anything around the neck or in a way that cannot be released at once.
Play only with a consenting adult partner. Agree your limits before you start.
Alcohol: if you have been drinking, skip cards that involve spinning, lifting, carrying or moving while blindfolded.
Every card and level is optional. Either of you can skip any card, or stop the game, at any time. The forfeit for knocking the tower over is only something you both agree to.
If your partner has a food allergy, do not kiss after eating or drinking that allergen. Skip kissing cards if either of you has a cold sore or infection.
general: WARNING: Adult game for ages 18+. Not suitable for children.
Keep the blocks, cards and accessories out of reach of children and pets.
Keep the travel bag and its drawstring away from children. Risk of strangulation.
Remove and dispose of all plastic packaging. Keep it away from children. Risk of suffocation.
Blindfold: a blindfolded player must not move around alone. If a card asks you to move while blindfolded, your partner must guide you slowly by the hand.
Before play, clear the play area of candles, glass, hot drinks and other hazards.
Remove the blindfold immediately if you feel any discomfort, pressure on the eyes or skin irritation.
Never place the blindfold strap or ties around the neck. Do not use the blindfold if it is damaged.
Not for use near open flames. Keep the blindfold and bag away from candles, fires and other heat sources.
Play on a stable, level surface. Falling blocks can hurt hands and feet.
Check the blocks before play. Do not use any block that is cracked or splintered.
Do not throw the blocks. Use them only for this game.
care: Wipe clean only, with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Do not soak the blocks or put them in a dishwasher.
Store in a dry place in the box or travel bag, away from children and pets.
